carpet-gui.workspace.help_body:
Open a mod from Quick access.

Filter or search its rules, then edit the value directly in its row.

Set Default saves the world configuration. Reset restores the declared default.

Enter submits text. Esc cancels a draft; press Esc again to leave the screen.
